### 适用引擎

- RDS SQL Server

- [RDS Custom for MySQL简介](~~2844223~~)

descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engine

SQL Server

### [](#)References

[Introduction to ApsaraDB RDS Custom](~~2864363~~)

### [](#)Precautions

If the RDS Custom instance uses a public IP address, the public IP address is automatically released after you associate an EIP with the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds associate-eip-address-with-rc-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id rc-i322y2t562oh7o000000 --allocation-id eip-bp166out2x4bpcf000000 --region cn-hangzhou
